reuse.R11_score_reliability: Reuse seal-before-index/GT, checkpoint/program/source/manifest hashing, nativeyaw0 fixedselected general3D float64 IoU, explicit no-silent-skip failure receipt. Do not import R11 11arms, candidateC selection or coordinate/rGB score labels unchanged.
reuse.R11_metrics: Reuse paired signed effect, source/common-mask denominators, separate center/size errors and descriptive scene clustering. Dynamic explicit arm_names/roles from new frozen plan, not arbitrary aliases.
reuse.R11_audit: Independent postseal scalar reductions retain allplanned arms, strict>.25/.5, failures/negative/zero/NA and full/commondenominator populations. No new GT read by reduction auditor.

source_contract: strict FP32 flags and original preprocessing
prediction_contract: all arm names+roles and selected query perarm
direct pseudo targets/masks/weights perarm, same-information no-update role
percoordinate actual-change masks, sourceprior/observational provenance and bounded correction
independent fullframe instance-generation input hashes/config (noq0seed), association ambiguity/rejects
temporal support frame/timestamp/pose/calibration/motion provenance and actual source-to-anchor transform hash
camera invalid/missing pose/no static support/moving rejection/ambiguous instance/numerical failure flags
presealed eligibility/common-population masks built without GT
all prediction/config/program/source/helperweight hashes and explicit labels-not-read state

temporal_contract.motion: static valid compensation separate from dynamic object correspondence; dynamic/unknown motion contributions reject unless independently verified
temporal_contract.wrong_control: Predeclared permutation/mismatch and identity mapping hashes before GT; same source and budget, explicit support/FOV/skip counts. Not a novel domain or automatic matchedcoverage experiment.

cohort.exclude: R9/R10/R11/smoke anchorIDs and physicalpointpaths where possible, input-only; disclose shortfalls and support reuse
cohort.exposure: TargetVAL and scenes research-exposed; new anchor subset is exploratory, neighbors are not extra independent test cases.

postseal_metrics: all-anchor mIoU/strict Acc25/50 and coordinate errors
same presealed common eligible/changed masks across arms
positive/negative/zero signedcounts and sums, harmfulmass, full negative tails
actualchange vs accepted vs undefined vs explicit failure denominators
per-scene and scene-equal paired effects; no independent-point/frame significance
GT postseal identity diagnostic only if separately specified, never Ginput/selection
not_yet_locked: frozen independent fullframe mask helper and target association
literal minimal arm set and genericattenuation definition
actual NPZ fields, run budget and GT release schema
